episodes.synopsis: The miracle drug, Hapna, now threatens to wipe out humanity. A chronic jail-breaker named Axel is asked to find the only man with a cure: Dr. Skinner.
episodes.title: Goodbye Cruel World

episodes.synopsis: Genius hacker Eleina finds a potential lead to Skinner. The Lazarus team splits into two groups to investigate it, but both end up getting shot at.
episodes.title: Life in the Fast Lane

episodes.synopsis: Searching Skinner's house and interviewing his old colleague reveals a new lead. Axel and Leland go to Istanbul but have trouble with local thugs.
episodes.title: Long Way from Home

episodes.synopsis: The team investigates a club owned by a stockbroker who got rich off Hapna. One of his associates is the hacker Dr. 909, who may be helping Skinner.
episodes.title: Don't Stop the Dance

episodes.synopsis: The team tries to lure Skinner out of hiding with a fake cure staged by the president of Delta Medicinal, but a hacker named Popcorn Wizard butts in.
episodes.title: Pretty Vacant

episodes.synopsis: A secluded commune where Eleina once lived is identified as a potential hiding spot for Skinner. She and Leland infiltrate it to find out for sure.
episodes.title: Heaven Is a Place on Earth

episodes.synopsis: Coordinates from an AI lead to islands that Skinner bought just before they sunk under rising sea levels. The team visit them hoping to learn more.
episodes.title: Almost Blue

episodes.synopsis: Chris is held captive on an arctic oil rig by Russian operatives. The team unites to save her, despite learning Chris was once a Russian spy herself.
episodes.title: Unforgettable Fire

episodes.synopsis: An inquiry is held at the Pentagon to determine the future of Lazarus where information emerges that prompts Schneider of INSCOM to hire an assassin.
episodes.title: Death on Two Legs

episodes.synopsis: Skinner's medical history provides a lead but requires entry to a private clinic. Leland takes Axel and Doug to his home to secure them an invite.
episodes.title: I Can't Tell You Why

episodes.synopsis: Doug and Eleina go to Islamabad seeking the elusive hacker but are pursued by INSCOM. Meanwhile, Axel gets into a chaotic fight with the assassin.
episodes.title: Runnin' with the Devil

episodes.synopsis: Eleina gets a lead to Skinner from Popcorn Wizard, but with Hersch, Axel, and Doug out of commission, it's up to Chris and Leland to crack the case.
episodes.title: Close to the Edge

episodes.synopsis: Abel conducts a raid to free Hersch, while Axel sneaks off to face his nemesis. The rest of the team pursues Skinner in a final bid to save humanity.
episodes.title: The World Is Yours
